Nina: i'll bring napkins + disposable chopsticks

Jules: stakes accepted. may the tastier lunch win.
Carlos: also FYI — found a stash of promo stickers in the kitchen. grab one for luck :star-struck:

Ivy: fair
Nina: worth the suspense :yum:
